component.name: TermPilot
component.summary: Terminals and desktops your agent can keep using

description.p: TermPilot is a desktop application for SSH, Telnet and serial terminals plus VNC and RDP desktops. You sign in yourself, then an AI agent continues on the same session or the same desktop through the built-in MCP server.
Credentials are encrypted with the system keychain and stored only on this machine. There is no account system and no telemetry.

ul.li: Terminal tabs for SSH, Telnet, serial and local shells, with SFTP in the same window.
VNC and RDP desktops in the same window, with a shared text clipboard.
A built-in MCP server exposing 35 tools, bound to 127.0.0.1 and protected by a token.
